description: This file contains utility functions for handling MCP configuration records, including type guards, converters to string records, and string arrays, used for processing configuration data in the MCP system.

methods.name: export function isMcpConfigRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> { isMcpConfigRecord
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a value is a non-null object and not an array, used to identify MCP configuration records.

methods.name: export function toMcpStringRecord( toMcpStringRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a record of string keys and string values if possible; calls optional callback on dropped entries.

methods.name: export function toMcpStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | undefined { toMcpStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of strings if the value is an array containing strings.

ctags.name: entries
ctags.pattern: /^  const entries = value.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string");$/
